mentions.name: Local-first hardware build comparison app
mentions.description: A local-first app for comparing hardware builds down to the individual component feature level, covering specs, benchmarks, CPU extension support, lanes, speaker counts in specific laptops, Dolby Atmos support, and screen panel manufacturers. It aims to provide no-nonsense, real product comparison for transparent and fast decisions.
mentions.source_excerpt: Local-first app for comparing hardware builds, down to the individual component feature level: specs, benchmarks, even cpu extension support, lanes, how many speakers in X laptop, dolby atmos? screen panel manufacturer(s), etc. Basically, no-nonsense real product comparison for transparent and fast decisions.
